Package org.cyclops.integratedterminals.api.terminalstorage.event

Class TerminalCraftingJobFinishedEvent

java.lang.Object
net.neoforged.bus.api.Event
org.cyclops.integratedterminals.api.terminalstorage.event.TerminalCraftingJobFinishedEvent
public class TerminalCraftingJobFinishedEvent extends net.neoforged.bus.api.Event
An event that is emitted on the NeoForge event bus when a crafting job has been completed. This is the crafting handler-agnostic counterpart of the completion events that the separate crafting mods may emit, so that consumers don't need those mods on their classpath. This is only emitted for jobs that ran to completion, so not for cancelled jobs. This is emitted for every completed job, including the dependencies of a job. Jobs that were requested directly can be identified via isRootJob().
